items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a whole CD at the Vanguard with Louis Nash and Scott Colley.

ctx.x: I avoided all that stuff—the electronic doodads. I think I associated them with kind of loud music and rock ‘n’ roll. And Bob Brookmeyer… bless his heart… he wrote a piece for symphony orchestra, which I did in… Janie came with me… One of those countries in Europe. (laughs) And, and he had written a section where I had to use certain foot pedals. So I thought, well, that’s interesting. And then, I think especially after this long time in the hospital, my finger technique really was slow. And certain settings on a…
What does it do, technically, to… I mean, I think of the guitar and the hollow body and…
